West Coast drivers of the 1940 Ford modified the vehicle for hot rodding and cut the top off.

S01 E02 — Moonshiners and the 1940 Ford
Junior Johnson, Bill Elliott and others describe the impact of the 1940 Ford in America in the years following World War II.

description:
S01 E03 — Marty Robbins Resto
Ray restores the No. 777 Plymouth Belvedere driven by legendary singer Marty Robbins, and returns the vehicle to the racetrack.

title: AmeriCarna
description:
S01 E04 — Hot Rods and Dragsters
Drag racers Don Prudhomme and John Force; director Ron Howard; musician Mike Love; Tom Cobb's legendary roadster.

title: AmeriCarna
description:
S01 E05 — Buried Treasures
Time capsules from the 1970s; a Daytona race car is buried in a car hauler for nearly 40 years.

title: AmeriCarna
description:
S03 E08 — Dan Gurney -- The Eagle Soars
After locating a Gurney Eagle in a New Jersey garage, Ray scours the globe for a Gurney-Weslake engine to help get the vehicle back on the track at Indy.

title: AmeriCarna
description:
S04 E01 — Andretti Flies Again at the 100th Running of Indy 500
Ray restores the famous Brawner Hawk Indy car that Mario Andretti drove to win Rookie of the Year honors in 1965; the duo takes the vehicle to the Brickyard for the 100th running of the Indianapolis 500.

title: AmeriCarna
description:
S04 E02 — Two Juniors and El Laguna
Dale Earnhardt Jr. and Ray build a half-car half-truck El Laguna and have Al Unser Jr. race it against a vintage racing champion on a road course at Charlotte Motor Speedway.

title: AmeriCarna
description:
S04 E03 — Vintage Racing Takes an Awesome Turn
Ray and Awesome Bill Elliot team up in a Corvette against 33 former Indy racers and their pro-am partners at the Brickyard.
